name: typography
title: Typography
description: The brand's type scale as one part. Agencidev Sans for titles, ABC Diatype for text, Medium for small, labels in regular capitals, the system mono for code. Every variant is a type utility from the tokens.
use_for: Any text: page and card titles, a lead under a hero, body copy, captions, the capital label over a field or a list, inline code. Pick the step by role, not by look.
never: A size, weight or line height outside the scale: every step comes from tokens.css
Bold or semibold: Agencidev Sans runs at Regular, ABC Diatype at Regular and Medium
Capitals anywhere but labels and buttons, or tracking on them: the site's capitals are not tracked
Agencidev Sans for body text, or ABC Diatype for titles
Colors on text: type is white on black, muted in the neutral steps
source: shadcn's typography, drawn in the Agencidev tokens (brand/tokens.css, from the site's app/globals.css and components/page-tokens.ts): the near-black canvas and white ink, the greys, square corners with the 4px plate, ABC Diatype and Agencidev Sans, color changes on hover and press only.

examples.name: Article
examples.label: An article
examples.content:
import { Text } from '@/react/components/ui/Text' // shadcn's typography page in the brand: headings, a lead, paragraphs, a quote, a list and inline code, each a step of // the scale. export default function Article() { return (
Field notes How Acme shipped its onboarding. Six weeks, one team and every screen in the flow. Acme came to us with a signup that lost half its people on the second step. We mapped every screen before we drew a new one. What the map showed The people who stayed saw the product before the form. The ones who left were asked for a card first. Show the product before you ask for anything. What we changed
  • Open on the product, in use.
  • Ask for the card after the first project.
  • Cut the form to three fields.
Build it from the system Every screen uses the components in acme-ds , so the next flow ships faster. Ongoing monthly partnerships. Cancellable at any time No retainer minimums.
) }

props.name: variant
props.description: The step of the scale: display, hero, h1 to h4 (Agencidev Sans), lead, large, p, ui, small, muted, caption (ABC Diatype), label (capitals), blockquote or code.

props.name: as
props.description: The tag, in place of the variant's own (an h2 drawn as h1, a span drawn as caption).
